newsitem.title: USA: Mallon notes conversion of preferred shares.
newsitem.headline: Mallon notes conversion of preferred shares.

text.p: Mallon Resources Corp said on Friday that holders of 252,675 shares of its Series B preferred stock had elected to convert those shares into 280,747 shares of the company's common stock.

Following the conversions and related transactions, 135,200 shares of the Series B preferred stock remain outstanding, the company said. The number of outstanding shares of common stock increased to about 4,690,000 shares, it added.

The conversions "reduce, on a share-for-share basis, the company's obligation to periodically redeem shares of the preferred, thus freeing capital for use in our drilling program," said company president George Mallon.
Mallon Resources Corp is an oil and gas exploration and production company.
